summary: Full backend + mobile UI (390x844) test of piggery MQTT app. Backend 14/15 pytest pass (MQTT round-trips for setpoint/power, thresholds persist, alarm flags, history with curtain/chimney fields, events, simulator toggle). Frontend: all requested flows pass - fixed bottom nav switching views, single-chamber screen per tab, curtain values = 100 - open matching API, chimney gauge, power toggle RUN/OFF round trip, Dane view (plant tile, 5 charts render with SVG, event log, follows selected chamber), Ustawienia (sp +/- round trip, threshold save persists, alarm badge appears/disappears), PL/EN toggle, no horizontal overflow. One backend bug: alarm triggered via threshold change produces no ALARM event/notification.

critical.issue: When a lowered threshold puts a chamber into alarm, NO 'ALARM: Komora X' event is logged and no WS 'alarm' message (browser notification) is sent. RCA: set_threshold calls gateway.annotate(gateway.latest_state) in-place, so latest_state already has alarm=True; on next MQTT message _detect_alarms(prev, cur) sees was=True and skips. Fix: in set_threshold do prev=copy.deepcopy(gateway.latest_state); gateway.annotate(gateway.latest_state); gateway._detect_alarms(prev, gateway.latest_state) (or don't mutate latest_state in place).

minor.issue: chamber not range-validated (out-of-range silently ignored by sim but returns queued:true and logs event 'Komora 10: ...'); set_setpoint value not type-validated
Keeps persisting stale latest_state every 15s while simulator disabled/device offline (flat fake history)

ui_bugs.issue: Rapid double-click of + only adds 0.5 total (value computed from stale ch.setpoint before MQTT echo)
Empty/invalid input -> parseFloat NaN -> null -> 422, unhandled promise rejection, no error feedback to user

integration_issues.issue: send() swallows errors silently - no user feedback if command POST fails

issues: Humidity chart Y-axis auto domain goes to 105 (>100%) - clamp to [0,100]
Chamber names stay 'Komora 1/2/3' in EN (come from backend)

action_items: Fix missing ALARM event/notification when alarm is caused by threshold change (deepcopy prev + _detect_alarms in set_threshold)
Validate chamber range (0-2) and numeric value in CommandIn
Add error handling/feedback for threshold save and command send
Optional: clamp humidity chart domain, remove duplicate log line, skip history sampling while device offline
critical_code_review_comments: Gateway.annotate mutates shared latest_state from the API thread context while MQTT thread also writes it - edge-detection breaks (see critical bug)
Old /app/backend/tests/test_fatek_mqtt.py targets obsolete 'plc-01' API and should be deleted
